name: Benedict's Gate
address: 71 Saint Benedict’s Street, Norwich NR2 4FB, United Kingdom
about:
Benedict's Gate is a cosy student accommodation in Norwich, with a wide range of studio and en-suite room types. There is a gym, a small cinema and study rooms in the communal areas, and the rent includes electricity, water and property insurance. Located at 71 Saint Benedict's Street, Norwich NR2 4FB, Benedict's Gate student accommodation in Norwich is a 9-minute walk to the Norwich University of the Arts, a 27-minute bus ride to the University of East Anglia, and a 21-minute bus ride to City College Norwich. Benedict's Gate Norwich, is not only conveniently close to the school but also boasts a great range of amenities in the neighbourhood. A few minutes walk from the door is a pedestrian street with restaurants and shops all along the way. There are two large supermarkets downstairs, making it easy to buy daily necessities as well as eat in the neighbourhood.
 
Features
Benedict's Gate is a brand new 302-bed student residence in 2020, offering a variety of En-suite and Studio rooms to suit your needs, whether you're living alone or with friends, with the En-suite being located on floors 1-5, with higher floors offering better views. The accommodation is beautifully furnished, and all bedrooms have double beds, study tables and chairs, wardrobes, and plenty of storage space. The kitchen has a fridge, induction hob, extractor hood, microwave and cupboards. In addition, Benedict's Gate Norwich offers a wide range of student amenities, including a gym, study rooms, a cinema, a 24-hour laundry, and a bike storage area. In addition, all bills, including Wi-Fi and insurance, are included in the rent.
 
Location and What's Hot?
Benedict's Gate student accommodation Norwich is conveniently located near the city centre, with easy access to shops, restaurants, bars, and cafes. You will find everything on your doorstep. Farmfoods Ltd and Spice Land are 3 minutes walk away, Tesco Express is a 9-minute walk, and Norwich Market is an 11-minute walk, so students can easily buy fresh ingredients. Farmyard Restaurant and Pinocchio's restaurant are within walking distance, so there are plenty of options for eating out. Cupcake & Co is a 6-minute walk away for a relaxing afternoon coffee. Norwich Lanes and Sovereign House shopping centres are within a 10-minute walk, with various chain restaurants and well-known shops, perfect for student shopping. Furthermore, the Shopper's Supermarket is nearby, so students don't need to travel far for supplies and grocery shopping. If you're interested in historic places, you can't miss Norwich Castle and Strangers' Hall, steeped in Norwich culture and history.
 
Transport
With Benedict's Gate a 9-minute walk to Norwich University of the Arts, a 21-minute bus ride to City College Norwich and a 27-minute bus ride to the University of East Anglia, students will never have to rush to school again. Benedict's Gate Norwich is conveniently located near the bus and train stations. The Georgian Townhouse bus station is a 10-minute walk away, with several bus routes to all parts of Norwich. Norwich train station is a 20-minute walk, making it easy for students to travel to other cities in the UK.
 
Security and Service
Benedict's Gate student accommodation Norwich has a 24-hour electronic door entry system and a video surveillance system requiring visitors to pass through multiple gates. In addition, it also comes with basic contents insurance and a 24-hour emergency contact centre to help students with their daily lives.

name: Crown Place Norwich
address: Surrey Street, Norwich NR1 3RF, United Kingdom
about:
Crown Place Norwich is a modern student accommodation in Norwich with a wide choice of En-suite, Studio, and 1-bedroom. It is conveniently located in the heart of Norwich on Surrey Street, within a 25-minute bus ride from the University of East Anglia and just a 15-minute walk from Norwich University of the Arts, making it the ideal student accommodation. It has a wide range of in-house facilities, including free wifi, a fitness suite, a games room, a cinema, and quiet, comfortable study areas where students can relax and unwind. Collegiate Crown Place offers all-inclusive billing, covering water, electricity and internet. The flats offer 24-hour security access, security guards and 24-hour surveillance to ensure the safety of the students. In addition, there are many shopping centres, hypermarkets and restaurants close to Crown Place Norwich, making them suitable for students.
 
FeaturesCrown Place Norwich is a brand new student residence opening in 2019 and offers a wide range of En-suite, Studio and One-bedroom rooms to suit all types of students. Whether you want your own space or to socialise with a group of like-minded students, there is a flat to suit your needs.The accommodation has 705 beds, and all bedrooms have double beds, study desks and chairs, wardrobes, chests of drawers, and plenty of storage space. Shared kitchens include induction hobs, combi ovens, fridges and storage cupboards.In addition, Crown Place student accommodation offers a wide range of facilities for students, including a gym, study rooms, a cinema, an entertainment room, a party room, a Karaoke room, a dinner room, etc. Laundry room and 24-hour CCTV surveillance ensure you enjoy a safe stay at the apartment. High-speed broadband & Wi-Fi ensure seamless learning and entertainment. All-inclusive billing takes away all your worries. We hope that you can enjoy your study life in the UK while you study.
 
Nearby UniversitiesNorwich University of the Arts (NUA) – 15-minute walkUniversity of East Anglia (UEA) – 25 minutes by busCity College Norwich – 15-minute walk
 
Location and What's Hot?
Collegiate Crown Place is situated in the heart of Norwich, close to the large shopping centre Intu Chapelfield, department stores, and a variety of restaurants and bars. You will find everything surrounding you. Crown Place Norwich is a 1-minute walk to the Asian supermarket Lucky Fortune and a 9-minute walk to Tesco and Sainsbury's supermarkets, making it very convenient for everyday shopping. Starbucks Coffee is a 4-minute walk away, and the neighbourhood is also home to the tranquil Flock Coffee House and Bar Marzano, ideal for relaxing or studying. Nearby Chantry Place, John Lewis & Partners and All Saints Antiques Centre have everything you need for a modern and vintage shopping experience, while pubs such as Boom Battle Bar and The Pig & Whistle are ideal for a night out. With cultural attractions such as Norwich Castle, Strangers' Hall and Norwich Ghost Walks just a stone's throw away, Crown Place Norwich offers students a balance between everyday life and recreation.
 
Transport
Students can walk from Crown Place Norwich to City College Norwich in 15 minutes, Norwich University of Arts in 15 minutes, and the University of East Anglia in 25 minutes by bus, so students will never have to worry about missing a school lecture again. Crown Place student accommodation is conveniently located close to bus and train stations. Norwich bus station is just a minute's walk away, and there are many bus routes to all parts of Norwich. Norwich (NRW) train station is also close by, making it easy for students to travel to other cities in the UK.
 
Security and Services
Crown Place Norwich has 24-hour security, CCTV surveillance and several electronic gates that visitors must pass through before entering the halls of residence to ensure the safety of our students. In addition, the flats offer property insurance and parcel services to help students in their daily lives.
